component.name: Lovense Controller
component.summary: Control Lovense toys from your computer

description.p: Desktop app to control Lovense toys over Bluetooth from Linux: vibration, pump/rotate, keyboard hotkeys, react to application audio, local game API, and optional remote web control for a partner.

Program desktopowy do sterowania zabawkami Lovense przez Bluetooth: wibracje, pump/rotate, skróty klawiszowe, reakcja na dźwięk z aplikacji, API do gier oraz opcjonalne zdalne sterowanie dla partnera.

ul.li: Lush, Hush, Max/Max 2, Nora, Edge, Domi, Ambi and more

description.p: Fix Second Life HUD and browser remote after fresh Linux: public HTTPS URL for LSL, Cloudflare Bot Fight detection, ProxyFix, auto-start web panel + tunnel, ngrok / Tailscale Funnel / localhost.run modes.
Multi-toy support, GStreamer app-audio capture, GTK UI, Flatpak packaging.
